seoTitle: About PeriodReady | Our Story, Emergency Kits & Quality Promise
seoDescription: Learn about PeriodReady: discreet menstrual emergency kits for college & PG students and working professionals. Thoughtfully packaged, pocket-friendly, and ready in minutes.

problemSection.title: Periods Often Arrive Unexpectedly
problemSection.paragraph: Periods often arrive unexpectedly: in a lecture, at the office, on a commute or while travelling. The nearest store may be far or closed, buying pads feels awkward, and one surprise can ruin a whole day.

whatIsSection.title: A Stylish, Discreet, Ready-to-Use Kit
whatIsSection.paragraph: PeriodReady is a stylish, discreet, ready-to-use kit designed for exactly that moment. Everything needed comes in one small pack that looks like a normal pouch, so you are never caught unprepared.

whyItMatters.title: Saves Time
whyItMatters.description: No last-minute store search, and in an emergency you can order on a quick-commerce app and get it in about 10 minutes (where available).

whyItMatters.title: Saves Stress & Embarrassment
whyItMatters.description: Discreet look, plain unbranded packaging with zero awkward product labels.

whyItMatters.title: Saves Money
whyItMatters.description: Low entry price starting at just ₹49, and a combo cheaper than buying all three kits separately.

whyItMatters.title: Everything in One Grab
whyItMatters.description: No running to buy five different things. All hygiene and comfort essentials together in one pack.

whyItMatters.title: Stay Confident & Keep Going
whyItMatters.description: Stay confident and keep going with your day without hesitation.

ourPromise.title: Our Promise
ourPromise.statement: Quality products, honest pricing, discreet delivery.
ourPromise.tagline: Be Ready. Feel Confident. Keep Going.
